answer: The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 3 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. Because the pigment partition is computed from the gale history, the wharf audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
